what_this_is: The Workshop rows for the tools in tools/lessons-and-learning-paths: what each tool does, what it takes and gives back, and how it runs.

payload.label: Work out where a learner stands on a track
payload.job: See how far a learner is along a course, lesson plan or learning path, which step comes next, and what they last showed
payload.description: Give the tracks, their ordered steps and the learner's progress states, evaluation receipts, evidence and label rows, and (to look at one person) the learner. Returns, per track, the steps in order, the percent finished counted from the steps (a stored percent or a "mastered" label never counts), the step to do next, the latest evaluation the learner's state names, the three newest pieces of evidence, the label for the latest decision and the path: each step complete, active or locked.

learner_id.description: Look at this learner only; leave out to look at every learner's records

stepId.description: The step evaluated (required when the decision finishes it)

evidenceRefs.description: What was evaluated; at least one

completed.description: True only if the step is finished

presentations.description: The words to show for each decision key

record_model._what: Moved here from tools/keep-a-record-library-valid, where they were held unchanged after the engine's one record model left it (old trillion src/record-model.json and src/record-indexes.json): the kinds this tool's job keeps, each as old trillion declared it.

payload.label: Plan the write that accepts an evaluation of a learner's step
payload.job: Accept the result of judging a learner's work on a step: the receipt to keep and the learner's next progress state, without applying one twice
payload.description: Give the evaluation receipt, the learner's current progress state (leave out if none) and the revision you expect it to be at, and the receipt already stored under that evaluation id if there is one. Returns the keep rows: the receipt and the next state, each with the value it expects to find in your store (the receipt not yet stored; the state as you gave it), so your store keeps each one only where it still holds that value. The step is finished only if the receipt's decision says so. The same receipt again returns idempotent with no keep rows; a different receipt under the same id, a stale revision, a state that belongs to another learner or track, or an unsound receipt is refused with the reason.

stepId.description: The step evaluated (required when the decision finishes it)

evidenceRefs.description: What was evaluated; at least one

completed.description: True only if the step is finished

current_state.description: The learner's progress state stored now; leave out if there is none

expected_state_revision.description: The revision you read the state at (0 when there is none)

stepId.description: The step evaluated (required when the decision finishes it)

evidenceRefs.description: What was evaluated; at least one

completed.description: True only if the step is finished

stored_receipt.description: The receipt stored now under this evaluation id, if any

expected.description: The record as you gave it for this ref: null for the receipt (not stored yet), the state as you gave it for the state (null when there is none)

payload.label: Show the courses a learner is on, lesson by lesson
payload.job: Show the learning page for one learner: each course as its lessons in order, how many are done, the lesson they are on now, and each lesson's words
payload.description: Give the courses (each with its id, title, about and lessons with id, title and body) and the lessons this learner has finished as { course_id, lesson_id }. Returns each course with how many lessons are done, and each lesson with its status: complete when done, active for the first lesson not done, locked for the rest, plus its words. A lesson with an interactive module is marked interactive. Nothing is read or written here.

screen.label: Lesson
screen.about: Read one lesson: its notes, the resources it names and what to try now.

provenance.source: bitfield-packages packages/learning-progress and packages/learning-path, and packages/course-lesson (its lesson page, moved byte for byte)

payload.label: List the courses a learner is on
payload.job: Show the learner their courses as a list: each course, how many lessons are done, and each lesson complete, active or locked. Opening a lesson opens it in the lesson screen.
payload.description: Give the courses (each with its id, title, about and lessons with id, title and body) and the lessons this learner has finished as { course_id, lesson_id }. Returns each course with how many lessons are done, and each lesson with its status: complete when done, active for the first lesson not done, locked for the rest. Nothing is read or written here; the course list screen runs the same read in the page.

screen.label: Courses
screen.about: Your courses, lesson by lesson. Open a lesson to read it and mark it done.

provenance.source: new with the course list screen; the read is the one of tool:show-the-courses-a-learner-is-on (read-data/courses-of-a-learner.mjs)

payload.label: Read a course
payload.job: Read one course with its lessons in order and which the learner has done
payload.description: Answers the course named by course: its title and description, its lessons in order each with its address (from lesson_path) and a done mark when person is named, and how many are done. An unknown course is refused by name. The answer is the props of show/Course.tsx.

database.description: The name of the pursuit database to read, bound by the trusted caller. The engine opens it with the login its vault holds as that name and -connection; no caller supplies a login.

use.description: The use this statement runs for: a recipe step's declared purpose and surface (config.context.use, set by the workflow engine over any use the step's input carried). Given with database, the computer opens the database with its reader login (one that cannot get round the row rules, change a table or read the use binding) instead of the owner's, and hands the run a ticket of this use that it signed; the statement's transaction claims it first, so the database's row rules read this use and the statement cannot change it. A use with credential_name, which has no ticket, is refused. Absent: the owner's own work, read under the database's own purpose_when_unstated.

purpose.description: The purpose path, such as publish or coach/review.

surface.description: The surface path, such as social/instagram; empty for any surface.

person.description: The signed-in learner, named by the trusted caller (the page's own sign-in or the member's pass); never chosen by a browser or an AI's arguments.

tables.description: Names of the pursuit tables to read in place of the defaults (courses, lessons, words, links, done); each a plain lower-case table name.

lesson_path.description: A path template for lesson addresses, such as /courses/{course}/lessons/{lesson}; without one an address is the bare lesson id.

provenance.source: Written in tools/lessons-and-learning-paths/do-work from the course and lesson reads of the pages it replaces, made generic; read through run-sql-in-my-database/do-work/serve-a-read.ts

payload.label: Read a lesson
payload.job: Read one lesson with its recording, its timed words and the lessons around it
payload.description: Answers the lesson named by lesson in the course named by course: its title and done mark, its recording (a YouTube embed address, or a file address, or none), its words cut into timed passages with their speakers, and the lessons before and after. files_base_url is put in front of a stored recording key. The answer is the props of show/Lesson.tsx.

payload.label: Mark a lesson done
payload.job: Mark one lesson of a course done for the signed-in learner
payload.description: Writes one done row for the named learner, course and lesson when the lesson is one of the course's own and is not already marked; marking twice adds no second row. Answers whether a row was added.
